The fix is in `src/agent.ts`, but I have not seen it work in the pane. The existing `src/agent.test.ts` passes (11 tests), and I added no new test for this case.

**Cause:** this is my reading of the code, not a confirmed reproduction. When a message has blocks that were never streamed, every block got the same key, `<msgId>:x0`. A text block and a tool call in one message then shared one bubble. The tool call took the text bubble's agent style instead of the monospace tool-call style. It also stayed outside the collapsed tool group.

**Fix:** `claim()` now records each unmatched block as claimed. Each block in a message gets its own key.
